en.title: The grammar categories at a glance
en.summary: Grammar categories describe the changes a word can show: number, gender, case, person, tense, mood, voice and aspect.

paragraphs: Grammar categories describe the kinds of change a word can show. The main ones are number, gender, case, person, tense, mood, voice and aspect. Languages differ in which categories they use and on which words they show them. This overview helps you to compare English with your own language.

English marks few of these on nouns. Nouns change for number and the possessive. Pronouns change for case, person and gender. Verbs change for tense, person, mood, voice and aspect, but with few endings and many helping words. Adjectives do not change at all.

blocks.html:
CategoryWhere English shows it
numberdog, dogs
caseI, me, my
genderhe, she, it
personI walk, she walks
tensewalk, walked, will walk

paragraphs: English nouns have no grammatical gender and no case endings. Adjectives do not agree with nouns. Where other languages use endings, English uses word order and small words such as of, to and the.

English shows mood with modal verbs: she must go, she might go. It shows voice with be and a participle: The door was opened. It shows aspect with be and -ing, or have and a participle: She is working, she has worked.

items: Wrong: **She walk to school.** Right: **She walks to school.**
Wrong: **the table, she is big** Right: **the table, it is big**

ro.title: Categoriile gramaticale pe scurt
ro.summary: Categoriile gramaticale sunt trăsături precum genul, numărul, cazul, persoana sau timpul, după care cuvintele își schimbă forma.

paragraphs: În limba română, cuvintele își schimbă des forma. Categoriile gramaticale sunt trăsăturile exprimate prin aceste forme, precum genul, numărul sau timpul acțiunii.

items: Eu citesc **o carte**, dar tu citești **două cărți**.
El este **prietenul meu**, iar ea este **prietena mea**.

paragraphs: Substantivele au trei genuri și își schimbă terminația pentru număr și caz. Articolul hotărât se leagă direct la sfârșitul substantivului. Verbele își schimbă forma după persoană, timp și mod.
